evidence: We need to take an honest look at how the team is performing.
The team has pockets of greatness in design, but it still struggles to deliver consistently.
Our next step is to make those strengths part of our everyday process.

output.teacher_note: 这句话先肯定团队设计上的局部亮点，再转折指出整体交付不稳定的问题，是绩效复盘里很典型的客观评价句式。记忆时可以把 pockets of greatness 当作固定短语，搭配 but 转折结构一起套用。

reusable_patterns.template: [The team] has pockets of greatness in [area], but it still struggles to deliver consistently.
reusable_patterns.rationale: 可迁移到各类团队绩效复盘、项目评估的客观评价场景。
